# DE102022110131A1 — Zusammensetzung fur Hybridpolymere mit Barrierefunktion

**Assignee:** Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft (DE) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** LOW | **Territory:** Germany (national)

## Summary
สิทธิบัตรโดย Fraunhofer ครอบคลุมสูตร composition สำหรับสร้าง inorganic-organic hybrid polymer (sol-gel derived) ที่ใช้เป็นชั้นกั้นก๊าซ (barrier layer) สูตรประกอบด้วย (A) ≥30 mol% SiX₄ silane ที่มี 4 hydrolysable groups, (B) ≥30 mol% silane ที่มี organic crosslinkable groups, และ (C) ≥10 mol% metal alkoxide (Ti หรือ Zr) hybrid polymer ที่ได้มีความสมดุลระหว่าง crosslink density สูงและความเหนียว (ไม่เปราะ) เหมาะสำหรับเคลือบบน flexible substrate รวมถึง mono-material packaging

## Key Technology
Sol-gel hybrid polymer coating สำหรับ barrier layer; สังเคราะห์จาก silane (A)+(C) hydrolytic condensation + organic crosslinking ของ silane (B); สามารถเคลือบบน PE, PP, หรือ paper ได้ในฐานะ barrier แทน AlOx หรือ SiOx; เปิดทาง recyclable mono-material packaging ที่ไม่ต้องมีชั้น EVOH

## FTO Assessment
**Risk:** LOW
**Reason:** เทคโนโลยีนี้เป็น coating chemistry (sol-gel) ที่แตกต่างจาก PE resin หรือ blown/cast film extrusion อย่างสิ้นเชิง; Fraunhofer เป็นสถาบันวิจัย ไม่ใช่ผู้ผลิต PE resin หรือ film converter; claims เน้น coating composition ไม่ใช่ film structure หรือ resin grade; ไม่มี FTO concern สำหรับ PE resin producer
**Action:** Watch only — หากบริษัทพัฒนา barrier coating product line ในอนาคตให้ตรวจสอบซ้ำ

# DE102022133229A1 — Kunststofffolie und Verfahren zu deren Herstellung

**Assignee:** Constantia Pirk GmbH & Co. KG (DE) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH | **Territory:** Germany (national)

## Summary
สิทธิบัตรโดย Constantia Pirk (converter รายใหญ่ EU) ครอบคลุม multilayer mono-material plastic film สำหรับบรรจุภัณฑ์อาหาร (โดยเฉพาะกาแฟ) ที่ทดแทน aluminium laminates โครงสร้างมี base layer และ cover layers ทั้งสองด้าน ผลิตด้วย extrusion; นวัตกรรมหลักคือการใส่วัสดุปรับปรุง dead-fold (คุณสมบัติไม่คืนตัวหลังพับ เช่น hydrocarbon resin/Twistharz) ลงในชั้น film ทำให้ mono-material PP หรือ PE film มีคุณสมบัติ dead-fold angle <20-30° เทียบเท่า PET/Al/PE laminate แบบดั้งเดิม

## Key Technology
Multilayer extruded mono-material film (PP หรือ PE preferred) + dead-fold improver (hydrocarbon resin/"Twistharz") ใน cover layer; ช่วยให้ mono-material packaging มีคุณสมบัติ dead-fold เทียบเท่า aluminium; recyclable และ sustainable; film thickness: base >10 µm, cover >1 µm; รวม ≤300 µm

**Risk:** HIGH

**Action:** ด่วน — ทำ claim mapping กับ PE film grades ของเรา; ปรึกษา legal counsel; monitor prosecution อย่างใกล้ชิด; ดู DE102023103371A1 ด้วย (Constantia รายที่ 2)

# EP2546056A4 — Method for Manufacturing Transparent Laminated Sheet, and Transparent Laminated Sheet

**Assignee:** Idemitsu Unitech Co. Ltd. (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** LOW | **Territory:** EP

## Summary
This patent covers a manufacturing method for a transparent laminated sheet consisting of multiple layers of crystalline resin — specifically polypropylene — where a second base layer with a higher melt flow rate (MFR) and shorter relaxation time is co-extruded with the first base layer and rapidly cooled to suppress spherulite formation. The invention improves transparency in crystalline resin sheets without nucleating agents. Both layers are polypropylene resin, making this a mono-material PP (not PE) construction.

## Key Technology
Co-extrusion of two polypropylene resin layers with differing MFR values followed by rapid belt-press cooling. The outer layer (second base layer) has an MFR at least 1.5x that of the inner layer and a relaxation time of 80% or less of the inner layer, reducing surface stress-induced nucleation and haze.

## FTO Assessment

# EP4096921A4 — High Scratch Resistant Laminate Tube with Metallized Polyethylene Layer Decoration

**Assignee:** AIRNOV PACK Co., Ltd. (TH) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM | **Territory:** EP

## Summary
This patent covers a laminate tube structure for food and non-food packaging (e.g., toothpaste, pharmaceutical, cosmetic tubes) that uses a metallized polyethylene film layer to replace traditional aluminium foil as the barrier element. The laminate tube construction comprises a metallized PE film sandwiched between inner and outer polyethylene layers, providing high scratch resistance and recyclability in conventional mechanical recycling streams. The invention enables PE-based mono-material laminate tubes as an aluminium-free recyclable alternative.

## Key Technology
Multilayer laminate tube comprising: (1) an inner polyethylene layer, (2) a metallized PE film layer (vapour-deposited metal on PE substrate, metal thickness ~20-1,000 Angstroms), and (3) an outer polyethylene layer — all-PE construction enabling mono-material recyclability. Claims cover both the tube structure and the laminated film or sheet used in its construction.

## FTO Assessment
**Risk:** MEDIUM
**Reason:** The patent involves polyethylene film as a substrate for metallized barrier structures in mono-material tube packaging. While the end-product (laminate tube) differs from typical flexible film pouches, the metallized PE film component could overlap with PE film supplied to converters making laminate tubes. The assignee is a Thai packaging company, meaning this is filed in close geographic proximity to our operations. However, claims are specific to the tube-format application and metallization process rather than broad PE film composition.
**Action:** Monitor. If we supply PE resin to converters making metallized PE laminate tubes, conduct freedom-to-operate review of claim 1 and dependent claims on film structure.

# EP4183565B1 — Bag Making Method and Welding Method

**Assignee:** Totani Corporation (JP) | **Status:** GRANTED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM | **Territory:** EP (38 states)

## Summary

This patent covers a bag making method and ultrasonic welding method for efficiently welding two portions of a gusset part to each other, where the gusset part is folded and interposed between two panel parts of a plastic bag or pouch. The method sandwiches and compresses panel parts and the folded gusset with a horn and anvil (having protrusions on the facing surface), then applies ultrasonic vibration to weld the two gusset portions together while the film web moves in the width direction. A cross-cutting step after ultrasonic welding produces the final bag.

## Key Technology

Ultrasonic welding process for gusset bag manufacturing with specific horn/anvil geometry (protrusions on facing surfaces), sandwiching panel + gusset + panel, welding gusset-to-gusset, then cross-cutting the web. Key claimed features include trapezoidal welded region geometry (longer length on inward side) and protrusion marks retained in the ultrasonic-welded area. IPC: B31B 70/66 (bag making), B29C 65/08 (ultrasonic welding). Material-agnostic process applicable to any thermoplastic film including PE pouches.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk level:** MEDIUM
**Reason:** Totani Corporation is a leading Japanese flexible packaging machinery manufacturer. This is a process patent for ultrasonic gusset welding in bag making — covers the manufacturing method, not film composition. If our PE pouch production lines use ultrasonic gusset welding with horn/anvil geometry matching the claims (vs. conventional heat sealing), this patent is directly relevant. Granted October 2025 — still within 9-month EPO opposition window (expires approximately July 2026). This is a strategic opportunity to consider opposition if the claims read on our manufacturing process.

Three-layer PVC composite film: outer PVC film (plasticized) + inner PVC foil (plasticizer-free, rigid) + outer PVC film (plasticized). All layers are PVC-compatible for zero-thickness butt welding and mono-material recycling. ## Summary

This patent covers a base body for a blister container and a blister container for packaging products, in particular pharmaceutical products such as tablets, capsules, pills, powders, vials, and syringes. The base body is obtained by cold forming and includes a barrier layer of aluminum and coating layers (heat-sealing lacquer and forming aid lacquer). The invention aims to provide a more sustainable blister container that avoids problematic multilayer structures like oPA/Alu/PVC while maintaining barrier performance comparable to traditional aluminum blister packs.

## Key Technology

Cold-formed blister base body with an aluminum barrier layer coated with: (1) heat-sealing lacquer on the inner surface to seal with covering film, and (2) forming aid lacquer on the outer surface. The coating allows cold forming without breakage while eliminating PVC layers. IPC codes: A61J 1/03; B32B 7/04; B32B 15/04; B65D 75/36; C09J 7/28; C09J 7/35 — pharmaceutical blister packaging. No PE film involvement.

The technology involves cold-formed aluminum blisters for solid dosage pharmaceutical products.

# EP4516842A4 — Stretched Film

**Assignee:** C.I. TAKIRON Corporation (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH | **Territory:** EP (38 states)

## Summary

This patent covers a stretched film for mono-material packing applications containing as its main component high-density polyethylene (HDPE) with density of 0.950 g/cm³ or more. The stretched film achieves water vapor transmission rate of 1.0 g/m²·day or less per 100 μm thickness, haze of 20% or less, and thermal shrinkage of 10% or less in the film stretching direction when heated at 100°C for 10 minutes. This addresses the need for mono-material recyclable packing films where HDPE provides the base film and a PE sealant film are both polyethylene.

## Key Technology

Stretched HDPE film (density ≥0.950 g/cm³) with combined property profile: water vapor barrier (≤1.0 g/m²·day per 100μm), transparency (haze ≤20%), and heat resistance/dimensional stability (thermal shrinkage ≤10% at 100°C). The invention specifically targets mono-material PE packaging where the base film and sealant are both polyethylene for recyclability. The sealant film is LDPE or LLDPE (lower melting point). IPC: C08J 5/18 (polymer films). Direct competitor to our MDO-PE/stretched HDPE film products.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk level:** HIGH
**Reason:** This is a direct filed application covering stretched HDPE mono-material packing film with water vapor barrier properties — precisely our product space (MDO-PE / oriented PE for mono-material recyclable packaging). C.I. TAKIRON Corporation is a Japanese packaging materials company. The claims target HDPE films with density ≥0.950 g/cm³ and specific WVT/haze/shrinkage combinations. If our stretched PE/MDO-PE films meet these parameter ranges, we would be in the scope of these claims if granted. Application published March 2025 — examination ongoing.
**Estimated expiry:** ~2043 (filing 2023 + 20)
**Action:** Full FTO analysis required Q2 2026. Monitor prosecution closely — track claims during examination. If claims granted broadly, design-around study needed. Consider prior art search to challenge.

# EP4538037A4 — Stretched Film and Method for Producing Same

**Assignee:** C.I. TAKIRON Corporation (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH | **Territory:** EP (38 states)

## Summary

This patent covers a stretched film for mono-material packing applications comprising a base layer containing HDPE (density ≥0.950 g/cm³) as main component and a barrier layer containing ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer (EVOH) as main component. The stretched film achieves water vapor transmission rate of 3.5 g/m²·day or less and thermal shrinkage of 5% or less in the stretching direction when heated at 100°C for 10 minutes. The invention addresses the problem that HDPE alone cannot provide gas barrier properties, while EVOH loses oxygen barrier performance under high humidity.

## Key Technology

Multilayer stretched film: HDPE base layer (density ≥0.950 g/cm³) + EVOH barrier layer + LDPE/LLDPE sealant film, stretched at 80–130°C with stretch ratio 5–10×. Key innovation is achieving both water vapor barrier (WVTR ≤3.5 g/m²·day) AND heat resistance (thermal shrinkage ≤5% at 100°C) simultaneously. The high-density PE (≥0.950 g/cm³) provides superior crystallinity and water vapor barrier vs. lower density PE previously used. IPC: B32B 27/28; B29C 55/02. The whole stack can be regarded as single-material PE (EVOH is minor component) for recyclability purposes.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk level:** HIGH
**Reason:** Same assignee as EP4516842A4 (C.I. TAKIRON) — this is a companion patent covering stretched PE/EVOH multilayer barrier film for mono-material packaging, directly overlapping our barrier PE and mono-material PE film product space. The claims cover a specific stretched film structure with HDPE base + EVOH barrier with defined performance parameters (WVTR, thermal shrinkage). If our barrier PE films use similar HDPE/EVOH constructions with these density and performance ranges, freedom-to-operate is at risk if granted.
**Estimated expiry:** ~2043 (filing 2023 + 20)
**Action:** Full FTO analysis required Q2 2026. Monitor prosecution closely alongside EP4516842A4. These two C.I. TAKIRON applications represent a coordinated patent family in our core product space — assign to IP counsel as priority pair.

# EP4551401A1 — MDO Film for Recyclable Laminate

**Assignee:** BEW-M GmbH (DE) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH | **Territory:** EP

## Summary
This patent covers a monoaxially stretched (MDO), transparent, monosorted (mono-material) PE film suitable for use as an outer layer in recyclable laminates. The film must have at least one outer layer and at least one inner layer, with the outer layer achieving a density of at least 0.94 g/cm3. The invention directly addresses the growing market demand for recyclable flexible packaging by replacing conventional PET/PE or PA/PE multilayer laminates with all-PE MDO-PE structures that meet recycling sorting criteria under EU regulations (PPWR).

## Key Technology
MDO-PE (machine direction oriented polyethylene) film in a multilayer mono-material construction: outer layer with density at least 0.94 g/cm3 (HDPE-range), enabling the film to serve as a rigid-feel, printable outer layer in PE-based recyclable laminates. Claims cover the film composition, layer density specification, and its use as a laminate component. Filed January 2024 as EP, published from WO 2024/008616.

## FTO Assessment
**Risk:** HIGH
**Reason:** This patent directly covers MDO-PE film for recyclable mono-material laminates — the exact technology space in which our PE resin customers (film converters) operate. BEW-M GmbH is a German machinery and film specialist. The claims on film layer composition (density thresholds at the outer layer) and application as a recyclable laminate outer layer could constrain PE resin grades we supply or recommend for MDO-PE applications. The 2024 filing date means the patent is still in prosecution and claims may yet broaden.
**Action:** Urgent monitor. Track claim prosecution via EPO register. Assess whether our recommended PE grades for MDO-PE outer layers fall within claim scope (density at least 0.94 g/cm3). Consult IP counsel before making grade-specific MDO-PE recommendations to converters. Review as paired family with EP4551402A1.

# EP4554792A1 — Multilayer Uniaxially Oriented Film

Blocked-blown multilayer MDO film structure: outer layers (A) comprising HDPE, core layers (B) comprising mLLDPE, inner blocking layers (C and C') comprising mLLDPE plus an EBA/EVA copolymer — all layers fused and collapsed before MDO stretching. Claims cover the specific layer composition (HDPE outer / mLLDPE core / mLLDPE+EBA blocking layer), the blocked-blown tube process, and the MDO stretching step. **Assignee:** Nippon Steel Corporation / 日本製鉄株式会社 (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** LOW | **Territory:** Japan

## Summary

This patent relates to a composite material formed by laminating a metal component (e.g., steel, titanium, aluminium) with a fiber-reinforced plastic (FRP) via a phenoxy resin-based adhesive layer (≥50 wt% phenoxy resin). The invention demonstrates a "super-additive" effect where the composite's maximum load exceeds the sum of loads from each component individually (law of mixture exceedance). The application targets lightweight automotive structural components, not flexible packaging.

## Key Technology

Metal-FRP hybrid composite with phenoxy resin adhesive layer; claims cover galvanised steel, electro-galvanised steel, and aluminium-coated steel substrates. IPC class B32B 15/14 (metal-plastic laminates), B32B 15/08, B29C 70/16, B29C 70/68.

# JP2020121455A — Packaging Material and Recycling Method

**Assignee:** Toppan Printing Co., Ltd. / 凸版印刷株式会社 (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM | **Territory:** Japan

## Summary

This patent discloses a recyclable laminate packaging material comprising at least one base layer and a multilayer sealant layer, where the sealant layer incorporates a cyclic olefin (COC/COP) resin-containing sublayer adjacent to the adhesive layer. After use, immersing the packaging in hot cooking oil (120°C, 30 min) reduces interlayer peel strength to ≤1 N/15mm, enabling clean separation of the sealant from the base layer for recycling. The recycling method uses thermal/chemical treatment to trigger delamination without adhesive residue.

## Key Technology

Recyclable laminate with cyclic olefin resin layer (環状オレフィン系樹脂) as the debonding trigger layer; sealant is polyolefin copolymer (claim 4). Base layer options include PET/PET, PA/PA, PET/PA laminates. Claim 7 is the recycling method. IPC: B32B 27/00, B32B 27/32, B65D 65/40. Total 7 claims filed 2019-01-30, published 2020-08-13.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** MEDIUM
**Reason:** Filed by Toppan, a known major packaging IP holder with aggressive enforcement history. The cyclic olefin interlayer concept for recyclable packaging is adjacent to our product space — if our PE pouches incorporate COC/COP as a tie or release layer, this claim could be relevant. However, the base layer in this patent is not all-PE (uses PET/PA substrates), limiting direct overlap with pure mono-material PE systems. The hot-oil delamination trigger is a niche test condition unlikely to match our product use cases.
**Action:** Monitor — check for granted B publication. Assess PCT family extensions into SEA/EU. Note Toppan's recycling-by-delamination strategy as competitive intelligence.

# JP2023007518A — Laminate, Recycling Method, and Recycled Resin Composition

**Assignee:** Toppan Printing Co., Ltd. / 凸版印刷株式会社 (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM | **Territory:** Japan

## Summary

This patent covers a PE/PP hybrid laminate incorporating a PE-PP block copolymer compatibiliser to enable high-quality mechanical recycling of mixed PE/PP packaging. The laminate has a first layer of PE resin and a second layer of PP resin, with 1–40 phr PE-PP block copolymer in at least one of the layers. This compatibiliser pre-dissolves in the laminate, so when it is mechanically recycled (shredded, melt-mixed with virgin PE or PP), the block copolymer enables the two immiscible polymers to form a compatible blend that retains sufficient mechanical properties. The patent also covers the recycled resin composition (claim 6), articles made from it (claim 7), and the recycling process (claims 8–9).

## Key Technology

9 claims: claim 1 = PE layer + PP layer laminate with PE-PP block copolymer (1–40 phr); claim 3 = optional gas barrier (vapour deposition with water-soluble polymer + metal alkoxide coating); claims 5 = Al/Si vapour deposition; claim 6 = recycled resin composition from melt-mixing; claims 8–9 = recycling method (crush → melt mix → blend with virgin resin, ≤70 wt% recycled content). IPC: B32B 27/32, B65D 65/40, C08J 11/06. Filed 2019-12-16, published 2023-01-19.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** MEDIUM
**Reason:** Filed by Toppan (high-risk assignee). This patent covers PE+PP hybrid laminates containing PE-PP block copolymer — directly relevant if our customers or our film products use PE/PP hybrid structures. The concept is important for the industry's transition to recyclable packaging where PE and PP layers are combined. Claim 1 is broad: any PE/PP laminate with PE-PP block copolymer at 1–40 phr could fall within scope. However, our pure all-PE mono-material products would not be covered (no PP layer). Risk exists if we supply PE for PE/PP hybrid laminate customers who use this approach.
**Action:** Monitor — check grant status. Note as intelligence on Toppan's approach to PE/PP hybrid recyclability. Assess whether any customer laminate structures use PE-PP block copolymer compatibilisers.

# JP2023019592A — Stretched Polyethylene Film

**Assignee:** Futamura Chemical Co., Ltd. / フタムラ化学株式会社 (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH | **Territory:** Japan

## Summary

This patent discloses a stretched polyethylene film for use as the base film in mono-material PE laminate packaging. The film is made from a blend of PE resin compositions: ethylene homopolymer or ethylene-olefin copolymer (density 0.940–0.970 g/cm³, MFR 0.1–10 g/10min) at 20–90 wt%, blended with lower-density ethylene-olefin copolymer (density 0.860–0.926 g/cm³, MFR 1.0–30.0 g/10min) at 10–80 wt%. The resulting blend has overall density 0.930–0.960 g/cm³, MFR 0.5–10 g/10min, and a specific DSC profile (ΔH_total 110–200 J/g; ΔH at 124°C fractionation ≥80 J/g). The film achieves rigidity, toughness, and heat resistance needed for a base film in PE mono-material laminates.

## Key Technology

5 claims: claim 1 = stretched PE film with specific HDPE/LLDPE blend composition and DSC thermal profile; claim 2 = elongation at break ≥40% (MD or TD); claim 3 = thermal shrinkage at 120°C ≤15% MD, total ≤25%; claim 4 = T-die cast and stretched film; claim 5 = surface treatment for wettability ≥36 mN/m. Directly targets MDO-PE base film for mono-material PE packaging. Futamura Chemical is a specialist film manufacturer. IPC: C08J 5/18, C08J 7/00, B29C 55/04, B29C 55/02, B29C 48/08.

**Risk:** HIGH

The specific PE blend composition (HDPE + LLDPE with DSC constraints) and film stretching process are highly relevant to our MDO-PE film production. While Futamura Chemical is not as large as Toppan or Toray, they are an active film manufacturer with packaging IP. The breadth of claim 1 (density range 0.930–0.960, broad MFR range) could capture many MDO-PE film formulations. This is an independent Japanese application with priority 2021-07-29 — relatively recent, likely to be examined.
**Action:** ESCALATE to FTO map. Obtain full English machine translation. Compare our MDO-PE film specifications (density, MFR, DSC profile) against claim 1 parameters. Identify prior art in stretched PE film technology pre-dating July 2021. Check for PCT family.

# JP2023020735A — Vapour Deposition Film, Laminate, Packaging Material and Packaging Container

**Assignee:** Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd. / 大日本印刷株式会社 (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM | **Territory:** Japan

## Summary

This patent covers a gas barrier vapour deposition film using a polyolefin/polyamide composite resin substrate with a vapour deposition layer on the polyamide surface. The polyamide resin layer contains both aliphatic polyamide (50–99 wt%) and semi-aromatic polyamide (1–100 phr relative to aliphatic PA), which improves gas barrier performance when vapour deposition is applied to the polyamide surface. The polyolefin layer can be polyethylene or polypropylene (claim 2). When PE is used (claim 6), the melting point difference between the crystalline aliphatic PA (Tm1) and the PE layer (Tm2) must be ≤90°C to enable good co-processing. The laminate (claims 10–16) adds a polyolefin heat-seal layer (PE or PP), enabling an all-polyolefin or near-all-polyolefin recyclable package.

## Key Technology

15 claims: resin substrate = PO layer (PE or PP) + PA layer (aliphatic + semi-aromatic PA blend) with vapour deposition on PA surface; laminate adds PO heat-seal layer; packaging container. Claim 8 = co-extruded resin substrate; claim 9 = stretched film substrate; claim 12 = PE or PP heat-seal + PE or PP base. Companion to JP2023020738A (same filing date, same inventors — anti-curl version). IPC: B32B 27/32, B65D 65/40, C08J 9/04, C08J 9/00, C08J 5/18.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** MEDIUM
**Reason:** Filed by DNP (Dai Nippon Printing), a major packaging company with known global IP activity. The film uses polyolefin (PE or PP) as one component of a composite base with vapour deposition. While not a pure mono-material PE structure, claims 2, 6, 12 explicitly cover PE-containing structures. The barrier vapour deposition + PE film architecture is relevant to our barrier PE product line. If our PE film is used as the PO substrate layer in such a composite vapour deposition structure, the claim may apply to the overall laminate our customers make.
**Action:** Monitor — check DNP PCT family filings. Assess whether our PE film customers use PA/PE co-extrusion for barrier applications. Note as competitive intelligence on DNP's recyclable barrier film strategy.

## Summary

This patent is the companion to JP2023020735A (same filing date 2021-07-30, same inventors), sharing the same polyolefin/polyamide composite substrate concept but with a specific focus on suppressing curl (カール). The resin substrate combines a polyolefin resin layer with a polyamide resin layer, where the PA layer contains crystalline aliphatic polyamide blended with non-crystalline semi-aromatic polyamide, and the PA layer forms the surface resin layer on one side. The non-crystalline semi-aromatic PA modifier reduces warping/curling during film processing and lamination, while maintaining gas barrier capability for vapour deposition on the PA surface. The polyolefin layer is PE or PP (claim 2), with PE specifically addressed in claim 7 (melting point difference constraint).

18 claims: resin substrate = PO layer (PE/PP, claim 2) + PA layer (crystalline aliphatic PA + non-crystalline semi-aromatic PA, forming surface layer); vapour deposition on PA surface; laminate adds PO heat-seal layer (PE/PP, claim 15); packaging container. Claim 9 = co-extruded film; claim 10 = stretched film. IPC: B32B 27/32, B32B 27/00, B65D 65/40, B29C 48/08, B29C 48/21. Note: Directly paired with JP2023020735A as a family member (different technical problem — curl vs. barrier — same base invention).

**Risk:** MEDIUM
**Reason:** Same assignee (DNP) and same filing date as JP2023020735A — these two patents form a dual-filing family covering the same PO/PA composite film substrate from different claim angles (barrier performance vs. anti-curl). PE is explicitly included as the polyolefin option. Risk level and reasoning identical to JP2023020735A. DNP has global IP presence and filing capacity. If our PE film is used in PO/PA composite laminate structures by converters, both this and JP2023020735A are relevant.
**Action:** Monitor — treat as family with JP2023020735A. Single FTO assessment applies to both. Check DNP PCT equivalents covering this substrate concept.

This patent covers an aqueous polyurethane-based gas barrier coating composition that maintains barrier performance after heat treatment (retort/boil sterilisation). The key innovation is using aqueous polyurethane resin (A) without large particles (no PU particles >20 μm equivalent diameter) combined with a water-soluble polymer (B), at a specific solid-content mass ratio A:B of 85:15 to 10:90. The gas barrier film (claim 3) applies this composition to a resin substrate; claim 6 specifically covers polyolefin film substrates. The laminate (claim 7) adds a sealant layer, and claim 8 specifies that both the resin substrate and sealant layer are either all-PE or all-PP, enabling mono-material recyclable packaging with retort-stable gas barrier.

## Key Technology

9 claims: claim 1 = aqueous PU + water-soluble polymer gas barrier composition (no >20 μm PU particles, ratio 85:15–10:90); claim 6 = polyolefin film substrate; claim 7 = barrier film + sealant laminate; claim 8 = all-PE or all-PP mono-material laminate (substrate + sealant both PE, or both PP). # JP2023047260A — Laminate and Packaging Container

**Assignee:** Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd. / 大日本印刷株式会社 (JP) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH | **Territory:** Japan

## Summary

This patent covers an all-PE mono-material laminate for standing pouches that achieves both good heat-seal strength and easy-tear properties. The base layer is a stretched polyethylene multi-layer film (延伸処理されてなるポリエチレン多層基材 = MDO-PE multi-layer). The heat-seal layer has two sublayers: layer 1 (innermost surface) = ethylene-alpha-olefin copolymer (low Tm ≤112°C, density ≤0.915 g/cm³ = LLDPE/VLDPE), and layer 2 = polyethylene (Tm ≥114°C). The structure enables low-temperature heat sealing via the soft LLDPE surface while the PE layer 2 provides structural support. The stretched PE multi-layer base (claims 5–8) comprises a specific 5-layer structure of MDPE/HDPE blends and LLDPE layers with density gradients ≤0.030 g/cm³ between adjacent layers.

## Key Technology

11 claims: claim 1 = laminate with stretched PE multi-layer base + two-layer heat-seal (LLDPE surface + PE inner); claim 5 = 5-layer MDO-PE base (MDPE/HDPE/MDPE+LLDPE/LLDPE/MDPE+HDPE); claims 10–11 = packaging container / standing pouch. Priority date 2021-09-24. DNP is a major packaging company with strong global IP posture. IPC: B32B 27/32, B65D 65/40.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** HIGH
**Reason:** This patent directly covers the mono-material PE standing pouch laminate — the same product space as our MDO-PE + LLDPE sealant all-PE packaging. DNP is a large, aggressive IP holder. Claim 1 captures: stretched PE multilayer base + two-layer sealant with LLDPE surface layer (Tm ≤112°C) + PE inner layer (Tm ≥114°C). This is an extremely common MDO-PE laminate construction. The 5-layer base specification in claims 5–8 is detailed enough to potentially map to commercial MDO-PE films. The standing pouch application (claim 11) is our target market. Risk is elevated because DNP, unlike smaller companies, actively enforces its packaging IP portfolio globally.
**Action:** ESCALATE to FTO map. Obtain full English machine translation. Perform detailed claim mapping against our MDO-PE film products and standing pouch structures. Identify prior art pre-dating September 2021. Check for PCT/EP equivalents — if DNP filed PCT, this becomes a global FTO concern.

## Summary

Optional AlOx/SiOx barrier film on substrate; 18 claims covering laminate, barrier variant, lid material, and container.

## Key Technology

All-PP laminate: OPP stretched substrate (higher Tim PP) / PP sealant (lower Tim PP); Tim differential ≥20°C (1st scan) / ≥10°C (2nd scan); optional vapour-barrier layer; wide seal window 130–190°C; 18 claims.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** LOW — Technology is entirely polypropylene-based (OPP substrate + PP sealant); no PE content; filed by DNP but outside PE mono-material scope; not relevant to PE resin business unless entering PP packaging space.

**US national phase entered:** 2022-04-08 (US17/767,592 → granted as US12104026B2)

| Territory | Number | Status | Date |
|---|---|---|---|

| **US** | **US12104026B2** | **GRANTED** | **2024-10-01** |

| EP | EP20789940.2A | Pending | — |

## Key Claims

1. Laminate with BOPE first layer + PE second layer, ≥90 wt% PE total
2. TREF fractionation spec: ≥8 wt% at ≤30°C; ≥20 wt% at >94°C; 40–64 wt% at 30–94°C

1. Map TREF specification against our BOPE-grade resin development targets — critical US FTO question

3. Monitor EP20789940.2A — EP grant would add third major enforcement territory

# CN119968429A — Polyethylene Blends Containing Virgin and Recycled HDPE Materials (Dow)

**Assignee:** Dow Global Technologies LLC (US) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

This patent discloses a high-density polyethylene blend composition combining 25–90 wt% post-consumer recycled HDPE with 10–75 wt% virgin bimodal HDPE. The virgin bimodal HDPE component has a density of 0.940–0.956 g/cc and a melt flow index (I21) of 25–40 g/10min. The blend targets blow-molded articles and is designed to deliver good melt strength, stiffness, and toughness comparable to virgin-only materials.

## Key Claims

- Blend composition: 25–90 wt% recycled HDPE + 10–75 wt% virgin bimodal HDPE
- Virgin bimodal HDPE density: 0.940–0.956 g/cc (narrowed in dependent claims to 0.945–0.955 g/cc)
- Virgin bimodal HDPE I21: 25–40 g/10min (narrowed to 28–35 g/10min in dependent claims)
- Blend density: 0.950–0.965 g/cc; blend I21: 28–60 g/10min
- At least 45 wt% (and up to 70 wt%) recycled HDPE in preferred embodiments
- ESCR ≥ 30 hrs (ASTM D1693-13, Cond. B, 10% surfactant) and melt strength ≥ 8.5 cN
- Virgin bimodal HDPE molecular structure: HMW fraction 22.5–29.4 wt%, LMW fraction 77.5–70.6 wt%; Mw/Mn ratio 12–18, Mz/Mw 15.0–17.0
- ESCR ≥ 300 hrs (ASTM D1693-15, Method B, 10% Igepal, F50) in preferred embodiments
- Application: blow molding method and blow-molded articles

## PE Packaging Relevance

This Dow patent directly addresses the market need for high-PCR-content HDPE resins suitable for blow-molded packaging (bottles, drums, containers). If granted in China, it could restrict converters using Dow's bimodal HDPE grades combined with rHDPE from achieving freedom-to-operate without licensing. Resin producers competing with Dow in supplying high-rPE blow-molding grades should monitor this application's progress through examination.

# EP4450247A3 — Method for Purifying Reclaimed Polypropylene (Procter & Gamble)

**Assignee:** The Procter & Gamble Company (US) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** LOW

## Abstract / Technology

This patent application from Procter & Gamble discloses a solvent-based purification process for reclaimed polypropylene (PP), not polyethylene. The method involves extracting reclaimed PP with a first liquid solvent at defined temperature and pressure (T1, P1), dissolving the extracted PP in a second solvent to form a solution, settling and filtering the solution, and separating a purer PP product. The process targets removal of contaminants (colorants, odor compounds, impurities) from post-consumer PP recyclate to produce a purified rPP suitable for high-quality applications.

## Key Claims

- Method steps: obtain reclaimed PP → extract with liquid solvent at T1/P1 → dissolve in solvent → settle → filter → purify at T2/P2 → separate purer PP
- Targeted polymer: polypropylene (B29K 23/00 = PP), not polyethylene
- Solvent-based dissolution/reprecipitation purification route (dissolve-settle-filter sequence)
- Application number 24198345.1; priority date 20 June 2018 (US 201862687389P); A3 published 9 April 2025
- European search report completed 27 February 2025 (The Hague); examiner: Mooibroek, Tiddo
- Prior art cited: EP3112406A1 (P&G own family), WO2017/003802A1 (P&G), US2002/128394A1 (Gorski)
- IPC: C08J 11/08 (recovery of polymers from waste by dissolution); B29B 17/02 (separation of plastics); B29B 7/94; B29K 23/00 (PP)

## PE Packaging Relevance

This patent is peripheral to PE resin markets — it covers PP purification, not PE. However, it is strategically relevant as a signal of P&G's broader recycled polymer supply chain IP strategy: P&G is building a portfolio around chemical/solvent-based purification of PCR resins to secure high-quality recyclate for its packaging. The solvent purification methodology could conceptually be adapted to PE in related applications. For PE resin producers, this represents indirect competitive intelligence: brand owners like P&G are patenting their own recyclate processing know-how, potentially reducing dependence on virgin PE resin suppliers. Monitor for any companion PE purification applications from P&G.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** LOW

This application covers a PP purification process and does not contain claims directed to polyethylene compositions, PE film formulations, or PE packaging structures. Freedom-to-operate for PE resin and film producers is not directly impacted.

# EP4450553A3 — Method for Purifying Reclaimed Polyethylene (Procter & Gamble)

**Assignee:** The Procter & Gamble Company (US) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH

## Abstract / Technology
กระบวนการทำให้ polyethylene รีไซเคิลบริสุทธิ์โดยใช้ตัวทำละลายเหลวสองขั้นตอน ได้แก่ การสกัด (extraction) ด้วยตัวทำละลายที่อุณหภูมิ T_E และความดัน P_E ตามด้วยการละลาย (dissolution) ที่อุณหภูมิ T_D และความดัน P_D จากนั้นตกตะกอน กรอง และแยก PE ที่บริสุทธิ์ขึ้นออกมา กระบวนการนี้มุ่งกำจัดสิ่งปนเปื้อนในวัสดุ PCR-PE เพื่อให้ได้ polymer ที่มีคุณภาพเทียบเท่าวัตถุดิบ virgin สำหรับบรรจุภัณฑ์ผู้บริโภค patent ฉบับนี้เป็น A3 (amended search report) ที่ยื่นต่อ EPO ครอบคลุมรัฐสมาชิก EPC ทั้งหมด

## Key Claims
- การสกัด reclaimed PE ด้วยตัวทำละลายเหลว (fluid solvent) ที่อุณหภูมิ T_E, ความดัน P_E เพื่อผลิต extracted reclaimed polyethylene
- การละลาย extracted PE ในตัวทำละลายที่อุณหภูมิ T_D, ความดัน P_D เพื่อสร้าง first solution containing polyethylene
- การตกตะกอน (sedimentation) ของสารละลายที่อุณหภูมิ T_D, ความดัน P_D
- การกรอง (filtration) สารละลายเพื่อแยก purer polyethylene ออกจากตัวทำละลาย
- กระบวนการครบวงจรตั้งแต่ obtaining reclaimed PE → extraction → dissolution → sedimentation → filtration → purification → separation

## PE Packaging Relevance
กระบวนการทำให้บริสุทธิ์นี้ตรงกับความต้องการของตลาด flexible packaging ในการนำ PCR-PE มาใช้ในฟิล์มที่ต้องการความสะอาดสูง เช่น food-grade packaging และ personal care pouches ซึ่งเป็นธุรกิจหลักของ P&G เองหาก patent นี้ได้รับการ grant จะส่งผลให้ผู้ผลิต rPE ที่ใช้กระบวนการ solvent-based purification ต้องตรวจสอบ freedom to operate โดยเฉพาะรายที่กำลังพัฒนา chemical recycling สำหรับ PE film

## FTO Assessment
**Risk:** HIGH
patent นี้ยังอยู่ในสถานะ FILED (A3 = amended search report, ยังไม่ granted) แต่มี priority date ตั้งแต่ 20.06.2018 (US 201862687388 P) และมีสาขาในตระกูลเดียวกันหลายฉบับที่ granted แล้วในหลายประเทศ (เช่น JP 6549260 B2, JP 6549303 B2, RU 2687943 C1, RU 2691330 C1) ขอบเขตสิทธิ์ครอบคลุม solvent-based PE purification process อย่างกว้าง หากสิทธิ์บัตร EP ได้รับการ grant จะมีผลคุ้มครองทั่ว EPC territory ซึ่งรวมถึงตลาดบรรจุภัณฑ์หลักของยุโรปทั้งหมด

# JP2025531853A — Method for Purifying Recycled Polymer (Procter & Gamble)

**Assignee:** The Procter & Gamble Company (US) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

This patent discloses a multi-step process for purifying recycled polymers (PCR/PIR) to a higher purity grade by removing contaminants such as pesticides, alkylphenol ethoxylates, alkylphenols, bisphenols, dioxins, PCBs, metals, organic tin, phthalates, and PAHs. The process involves sequential leaching with organic solvents at near-atmospheric pressure and below the first melting point of the polymer, followed by supercritical fluid extraction (at 80–280°C, 150–8000 psig) and dissolution/filtration steps. The final purified polymer achieves average contaminant removal efficiency exceeding 75%, enabling post-consumer recycled resin to meet high-purity application requirements.

## Key Claims

- Claim 1: Multi-step method — leaching, extraction, dissolution, settling, filtration (mechanical + adsorption), and separation to produce high-purity recycled polymer with >75% average removal efficiency
- Leaching step: below first melting point, near atmospheric (~1,000 atm), >55% average removal efficiency per step
- Extraction step (step c): 80–280°C, 150–8,000 psig (1.03–55.16 MPa), first fluid solvent with normal boiling point <70°C
- Dissolution step (step d): 90–280°C, 200–9,000 psig (1.38–62.05 MPa)
- Leaching solvent (Claim 7): DME, diethyl ether, MEK, ethyl acetate, THF, acetone, methanol, CO2, or mixtures
- Claim 3: Leaching at 20–90°C, atmospheric to ~1,000 atm, ethyl acetate solvent, total residence <360 min, ~55% efficiency
- Claim 9 (specific): CSTR reactor with 3 leaching stages at ~77°C, ~20 min each residence time, ethyl acetate solvent
- Claim 12: Recycled polymer is PCR polymer
- Claim 13: Recycled polymer is PP homopolymer or copolymer (primary focus is PP, not PE)

## PE Packaging Relevance

The purification process is polymer-agnostic and explicitly covers PCR streams. While Claims 12–13 specify PP as the exemplified polymer, the method framework (IPC C08J 11/06, B29B 17/00) is applicable to PE PCR streams. If P&G or licensees apply this to PCR-PE for flexible packaging, it could enable high-purity recycled PE at scale, relevant to mono-PE structures requiring food-contact or near-food-contact quality rPE. The international filing (PCT/US2023/069218, priority US 63/408,525 filed 2022-09-21) indicates broad global reach.

# JP7615154B2 — Post-Consumer Resin Packaging (Unilever)

**Assignee:** Unilever IP Holdings B.V. (NL) | **Status:** GRANTED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH

## Abstract / Technology

This granted patent covers a sustainable multi-layer packaging article made from post-consumer resin (PCR) that contains less than 5 wt% virgin plastic. The multilayer structure uses an outer layer of natural-color PCR (N-PCR) from natural plastic waste, and an inner layer of N-PCR or colored PCR (J-PCR) where at least 50% is J-PCR. A key feature is the use of a NIR-detectable black masterbatch in the outer and/or inner layers, enabling NIR sorting at material recovery facilities (MRFs) — solving the long-standing problem that carbon black-colored PCR cannot be sorted by NIR and ends up as residual waste. The article contains >95% PCR and is targeted at FMCG packaging (non-food grade containers).

- Claim 1 (base): Multi-layer PCR packaging article with <5 wt% virgin plastic; outer layer = N-PCR; inner layer = N-PCR or J-PCR (≥50% J-PCR); NIR-detectable black masterbatch in outer/inner layer

- Claim 3: Inner layer = 100% J-PCR (colored plastic waste)
- Claim 4: Outer:inner weight ratio = 99:1 to 1:99
- Claim 5: Outer:inner weight ratio = 1:3 to 1:5
- Claim 6: Outer:inner weight ratio = 1:4
- Claim 8: N-PCR and J-PCR are recycled HDPE (from milk jugs / dairy containers and colored HDPE bottles)
- Claim 9: Article contains <3 wt% virgin plastic
- Claim 10: Article contains 0% virgin plastic

This patent application discloses high-density polyethylene (HDPE) blends comprising (a) 25–90 wt% recycled high-density polyethylene and (b) 10–75 wt% virgin bimodal HDPE copolymer with density 0.944–0.953 g/cc and melt index I21 of 8–12 g/10 min. The bimodal virgin HDPE component is designed to compatibilize with PCR-HDPE and restore mechanical performance, melt strength, and stress crack resistance that are degraded in PCR streams. ## Abstract / Technology

This patent covers blends of post-consumer recycled (PCR) polyethylene with virgin linear low-density polyethylene (LLDPE) specifically optimised for blown film production. The composition includes virgin LLDPE at 25–99 wt% and PCR-PE at 1–75 wt% of total blend weight, targeting sheets, films, pipes, strands, tubes, containers, or pellets. - PCR-PE content: ~1 wt% to ~75 wt% of total composition
- Film structure: three-layer blown film (A Layer / B Layer / C Layer)
- Target film gauge: 0.9 mil at 2.5 blow-up ratio (BUR) per test data

- Products: sheets, films, pipes, strands, tubes, containers, pellets

This is the most directly actionable patent for flexible PE film producers sourcing or blending PCR-PE. There is limited design-around space without moving to a fundamentally different polymer matrix (e.g., HDPE-dominant or non-PE multilayer structures). # US20240400769A1 — Method for Improving the Reactive Extrusion of a Polypropylene PCR (Braskem)

**Assignee:** Braskem S.A. | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

This patent covers a method for mechanical recycling of polypropylene post-consumer resin (PCR-PP) via reactive extrusion, using a polypropylene-based masterbatch containing a low-reactivity free-radical generator (peroxide) with a half-life greater than 20 hours at 120°C. The masterbatch is pre-compounded and then added to the PP-PCR stream in a screw extruder, enabling controlled radical-mediated chain modification during melt processing. The approach addresses the inherent variability in PCR feedstock by standardizing the peroxide delivery mechanism, improving melt quality and processability of recycled PP.

## Key Claims

- Method of mechanical recycling comprising adding a polypropylene-based masterbatch to a PP-PCR stream in a screw extruder
- Masterbatch contains a low-reactivity free-radical generator with half-life > 20 h at 120°C (e.g., Trigonox 311 class peroxides)
- Free-radical generator concentration and masterbatch formulation designed for controlled reactive extrusion in single-screw or twin-screw extruder configurations
- Applicable to PP-PCR streams with variable contamination and rheological profiles typical of post-consumer collection

## PE Packaging Relevance

This patent is primarily PP-focused, not PE. However, the reactive extrusion masterbatch methodology is directly transferable to PE-PCR upgrading (e.g., peroxide-mediated branching of LDPE-PCR or controlled viscosity adjustment of HDPE-PCR film streams). Braskem's filing signals competitive investment in chemical-assisted PCR upgrading that could extend to their PE portfolio and affect flexible packaging film recyclate markets where PP/PE mixed streams are common.

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** MEDIUM

The claims are narrowly scoped to PP-PCR reactive extrusion using a specific masterbatch delivery mechanism and peroxide half-life criterion. Direct FTO risk for PE flexible packaging processors is low since the substrate is PP, not PE. Risk elevates to MEDIUM because the methodology could be extended via continuation claims to cover PE-PCR or mixed polyolefin PCR reactive extrusion, and Braskem is a major resin supplier with broad patent prosecution history in Brazil and the US.

This patent discloses a multi-step process for producing high-purity post-consumer recycled polypropylene (PCR-PP) compositions. # WO2024186486A1 — Processes for Producing Upgraded Post-Consumer Recycled Polyethylene (Dow)

**Assignee:** Dow Global Technologies LLC (US) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH

## Abstract / Technology
This Dow patent discloses processes for upgrading post-consumer recycled polyethylene (PCR PE) by melt blending non-pelletized PCR PE with virgin polyethylene in an extruder to produce a PCR/virgin blend. The PCR/virgin blend is then melt filtered to remove contaminants and produce the upgraded PCR PE in a single, streamlined thermal cycle. The process specifically avoids multiple heating/cooling steps that degrade recycled material quality.

## Key Claims
- Melt blending non-pelletized (flake/grind form) PCR PE with virgin polyethylene directly in an extruder
- Producing a PCR/virgin blend in the extruder without intermediate pelletization of PCR PE
- Melt filtering the PCR/virgin blend to remove solid contaminants
- Producing upgraded PCR PE output suitable for packaging applications
- Single thermal cycle approach — avoids re-melting previously pelletized PCR PE (energy and quality advantage)
- IPC C08L 23/04 covers ethylene homopolymer compositions (direct PE claim)

## PE Packaging Relevance
This is a directly relevant patent for PE flexible packaging producers who compound or use PCR-PE. Dow's claimed process covers the core operation of blending non-pelletized PCR PE flake with virgin PE and melt filtering — a workflow that converters and compounders using PCR-LDPE, PCR-LLDPE, or PCR-HDPE in film extrusion may operate. The PCT filing (US priority 63/488,873, March 2023) with broad national phase coverage creates global FTO exposure.

## FTO Assessment
**Risk:** HIGH

Dow is a dominant PE resin supplier with aggressive IP enforcement. The process claims are broad: melt blending non-pelletized PCR PE with virgin PE + melt filtration covers a standard compounding workflow. Any film converter or resin compounder blending PCR PE flake with virgin PE resin in an extruder (without separately pelletizing the PCR PE first) could fall within claim scope. PCT with US priority — national phase entries expected in EU, CN, JP, and other key markets. Recommend legal review before operating non-pelletized PCR PE blending lines.

**Assignee:** Dow Global Technologies LLC (US) + Dow Quimica de Colombia S.A. (CO) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH

## Abstract / Technology
This Dow patent claims a multilayer film structure incorporating PCR polyethylene resin in at least one core layer, specifically engineered for higher tear resistance to overcome the mechanical property losses typical of PCR inclusion. The film has a first outer layer, second outer layer, and at least one core layer containing PCR PE with tightly specified density and melt index, combined with a controlled molecular weight distribution (MWD). The outer layers may comprise ethylene-based polymer, propylene-based polymer, or combinations thereof.

- Molecular weight distribution (MWD = Mw/Mn): 5 to 12
- First and second outer layers: ethylene-based polymer, propylene-based polymer, or combinations

- US priority: 63/517,027 filed August 1, 2023

## PE Packaging Relevance
This is a high-relevance patent for flexible PE film producers incorporating PCR content. The claims directly cover multilayer stretch film and flexible packaging film structures with PCR PE in the core layer — a standard configuration for PCR-containing films. The specified density range (0.930–0.950 g/cc) encompasses LLDPE and MDPE grades commonly used in stretch film cores. Tear resistance performance claims are critical differentiators in PCR film specification.

## FTO Assessment
**Risk:** HIGH

The density (0.930–0.950 g/cc) and MI (1.0–3.0 dg/min) specifications are standard for film-grade resins, meaning many commercial PCR-containing multilayer films could fall within claim scope. PCT with US priority and dual-country applicant (US + Colombia) signals global commercial enforcement intent. National phase entries in EU, Asia-Pacific expected. Critical to monitor claim scope in granted patents.

## Abstract / Technology
This patent from LyondellBasell's Equistar Chemicals discloses a method for making pelletized polymeric resin by blending a high density polyethylene (HDPE) base resin with a post-consumer resin (PCR) sourced from recycled intermediate bulk containers (IBCs), drums, pipes, and similar industrial/agricultural containers. - Second polymer component: PCR sourced from recycled intermediate bulk containers, drums, pipes
- PCR may comprise a first recycled polymer resin (IBCs) + second recycled polymer resin (small blow molded containers)

# AR122048B1 — SHRINK FILM AND ARTICLE WHICH IS PACKAGED USING A FILM COMPRISING SUCH SHRINK FILM (Dow)

**Assignee:** Dow Global Technologies LLC & Dow Chemical (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. | **Status:** GRANTED | **FTO Risk:** HIGH

## Abstract / Technology

This patent covers a collation shrink film (also known as shrink wrap film or heat shrink film) that incorporates post-consumer recycled (PCR) polyethylene — specifically recycled HDPE — into a film formulation that maintains the high shrinkage, stiffness, optical clarity, and low coefficient of friction (COF) required for commercial collation shrink packaging. The invention addresses the industry challenge that recycled materials typically degrade physical properties versus virgin resin. The film uses a blend of LDPE and/or LLDPE as the primary matrix with PCR HDPE as the recycled component to achieve both sustainability targets and performance requirements.

## Key Claims

- Film is a collation shrink film (CSF) containing PCR HDPE blended with LDPE and/or LLDPE base resin
- PCR HDPE sourced from post-consumer recycled streams (e.g., milk jugs, plastic bags, refillable bottles)
- Film must maintain: high thermal shrink force, high tensile strength, low haze, high gloss, good clarity
- Sufficient dimensional shrinkage for snug fit and low COF for machine runnability
- Three-layer film structure with controlled layer compositions to preserve mechanical performance with recycled content
- Applicants include both US HQ (Dow Global Technologies) and Malaysian subsidiary (Dow Chemical Malaysia), indicating intended enforcement across Asia-Pacific region

## PE Packaging Relevance

Dow is the dominant global supplier of PE resins for collation shrink films, and this patent — with a Malaysian co-applicant — signals direct commercial intent in Southeast Asia. Collation shrink film is a high-volume segment in Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Malaysia, used for beverage multipacks (water, carbonated drinks) and FMCG secondary packaging. This patent creates a potential barrier for converters and resin suppliers seeking to offer PCR-containing shrink film solutions competing with Dow's INFUSE or ELITE portfolio.

# AU2020378633B2 — A multilayer stretch film (Trioplast)

**Assignee:** Trioplast Smålandsstenar AB | **Status:** GRANTED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

This patent covers a multilayer stretch film comprising at least one core layer arranged between two exterior layers, with a total film thickness in the range of 5–40 µm, and incorporating 10–90% by weight of recycled post-consumer waste (PCW) polyethylene material based on total film weight. The invention is aimed at pallet wrapping and agricultural bale wrapping (silage) applications where high stretchability (>50% elongation), tear resistance, puncture resistance, and oxygen/moisture barrier performance are required. The core innovation is achieving commercial-grade mechanical performance in a stretch film while incorporating substantial recycled PCW-PE content, reducing fossil raw material consumption.

## Key Claims

- Multilayer structure: at least one core layer between two exterior layers
- Total film thickness: 5–40 µm
- PCW-PE recycled content: 10–90% by weight of total film
- Film must withstand >50% stretch during use (pallet and agricultural wrapping)
- Maintained elongation capability, tear resistance, and puncture resistance with recycled content
- Applications include pallet stretch wrapping and agricultural silage bale wrapping (anaerobic barrier properties required)
- Priority date: 08 November 2019 (EP 19208074.5); PCT filed 06 November 2020
- Australian acceptance date: 11 December 2025 (Accepted Journal Date)

## PE Packaging Relevance

Trioplast (operating as Trioworld) is a major European stretch film manufacturer competing in the global pallet wrap and agricultural film segment. The 10–90% PCW-PE content range is extremely broad and covers virtually all commercially viable recycled content levels, making this a strategically broad grant. In SEA, pallet stretch wrap is a fast-growing segment driven by e-commerce logistics growth in Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia. The agricultural film segment (silage bale wrap) is less relevant to SEA but significant in Australia and New Zealand where this patent is granted. This patent covers a polyethylene blend composition with improved elongation-at-break properties suitable for stretch wrap film applications. The blend consists of approximately 98 wt% LLDPE and approximately 2 wt% high-molecular-weight HDPE (HMW HDPE), where the HMW HDPE component has a weight-average molecular weight greater than 250,000 g/mol. # CN114953681B — A high heat-resistant shrinkable polyethylene film and preparation method thereof (Shandong Hongtu)

**Assignee:** Shandong Hongtu New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. | **Status:** GRANTED | **FTO Risk:** LOW

## Abstract / Technology

This patent covers a three-layer co-extruded high heat-resistant shrinkable polyethylene film and its preparation method, targeted at the PE release film (PE isolation film / 隔离膜) market, specifically for use as a waterproofing membrane release layer in construction applications (asphalt-based waterproofing coils). The outer layer uses unsaturated silane-grafted polyethylene blended with HDPE (grades 7000F/6888), the inner layer uses HDPE, LLDPE 7042, and mica masterbatch, and the bottom layer uses HDPE, LLDPE 7042, HDPE5200B, and mica masterbatch. - Inner layer: HDPE 7000F/6888 (3–6 parts) + LLDPE 7042 (1–3 parts) + mica masterbatch ≥800 mesh (1–2 parts)

# CN115141298B — Polyolefin resin and preparation method thereof (DL Chemical)

**Assignee:** DL Chemical Co., Ltd. (Korea) | **Status:** GRANTED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

สิทธิบัตรนี้ครอบคลุม LLDPE copolymer สังเคราะห์ด้วย metallocene catalyst ที่มีการกระจาย long-chain branching (LCB) คล้ายกับ mPE ทั่วไป กระบวนการผลิตใช้ pre-polymerization ใน slurry reactor ตามด้วย main polymerization ใน gas-phase reactor โดยใช้ ethylene และ 1-hexene เป็น comonomer เรซิน LLDPE ที่ได้มีสมบัติทางกลและความสามารถในการแปรรูปที่ดีเยี่ยม เหมาะสำหรับขึ้นรูปเป็น shrink film และ agricultural film

## Key Claims

- Density (ASTM D1505): 0.910–0.935 g/cm³
- MIE (MFI at 190°C/2.16 kg): 0.1–2.0 g/10 min
- MIF (MFI at 190°C/21.6 kg): 17–35 g/10 min
- Melt flow ratio SR = MIF/MIE: 40–50
- Molecular weight distribution Mw/Mn: 3.0–5.0
- Mz/Mw ratio: 2.0–3.5
- MD tear strength (ASTM D-1922) at BUR 2.5, film 30 µm: MD > [1/EXP(0.102×SR)] × 3000 + EXP(4.35/D)
- Catalyst: zirconocene organometallic compound + aluminoxane co-catalyst on silica/alumina support
- Pre-polymerization feed: 80–99.9 wt% ethylene + 0.1–20 wt% 1-hexene comonomer

## PE Packaging Relevance

สิทธิบัตรนี้เกี่ยวข้องโดยตรงกับตลาด shrink film เนื่องจากระบุการใช้งานเป็น shrink film และ agricultural film อย่างชัดเจน LCB distribution ที่ควบคุมได้ทำให้ฟิล์มมีความแข็งแรงสูง (MD tear) พร้อมแปรรูปง่าย ซึ่งเป็นคุณสมบัติหลักที่ตลาด PE shrink wrap ต้องการ เรซินประเภทนี้แข่งขันกับ mPE LLDPE จาก ExxonMobil, Hanwha, และ LG ที่อ้างอิงในสิทธิบัตร

## China Market Note

สิทธิบัตรนี้ยื่นและได้รับอนุมัติในจีน (CNIPA) โดยผู้ถือสิทธิ์เป็นบริษัทเกาหลี (DL Chemical) มีการอ้างสิทธิ์ความเป็นเจ้าของก่อน (priority) จากสิทธิบัตรเกาหลี KR 10-2021-0040511 (March 2021) ไม่พบหลักฐานการขยาย PCT ไปยังตลาดอื่น — ความคุ้มครองจึงจำกัดอยู่ในจีนเป็นหลัก แต่ต้องตรวจสอบสิทธิบัตรเกาหลีต้นฉบับแยกต่างหาก

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** MEDIUM

DL Chemical เป็นผู้ผลิต petrochemical รายใหญ่ของเกาหลี (เดิมคือ Daelim Chemical) ที่มีพอร์ตสิทธิบัตร polyolefin กว้างขวาง สิทธิบัตรนี้ครอบคลุม LLDPE ที่มีช่วงค่า density และ MFR กว้าง (0.910–0.935 g/cm³) ซึ่งอาจทับซ้อนกับ shrink film grade ของ GC ได้ ความเสี่ยงอยู่ระดับ MEDIUM เนื่องจากคุ้มครองเฉพาะในจีน แต่ลักษณะ claim เรื่อง LCB distribution + MD tear formula นั้นค่อนข้าง specific และอาจหลีกเลี่ยงได้หากออกสูตรเรซินต่างกัน

# CN116178829B — Unidirectional polyethylene shrink film with stable shrinkage rate and preparation method thereof (Shanghai Yunkai)

**Assignee:** Shanghai Yunkai Plastic Products Co., Ltd. | **Status:** GRANTED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

สิทธิบัตรนี้ครอบคลุม shrink film แบบ unidirectional (MD-only) ที่ทำจาก PE ล้วน โดยผสม HDPE ความดันสูง (LDPE), HDPE ความดันต่ำ, LLDPE, และ metallocene LLDPE (mLLDPE) ในสัดส่วนที่กำหนด ฟิล์มที่ได้มีอัตราการหดตัวที่เสถียร (stable shrinkage rate) ความใสสูง สมบัติทางกลดี และความแข็งแรงการซีลร้อน (heat seal strength) สูง กระบวนการผลิตใช้ blown film โดยควบคุม BUR (blow-up ratio) ไว้ที่ 3–3.5

## Key Claims

- สูตร (% โดยน้ำหนัก): LDPE 28–32%, HDPE 8–12%, LLDPE 35–45%, mLLDPE 15–25%
- MFI ของ LDPE: 0.30–0.35 g/10 min
- MFI ของ LLDPE: 0.8–1.2 g/10 min
- MFI ของ mLLDPE: 2.0–4.0 g/10 min (อาจใช้ mLLDPE 2 เกรด: เกรดแรก MFI 2.0–2.5, เกรดสอง MFI 3.5–4.0 อัตราส่วน 2.8–3.2:1)
- หรือใช้ modified mLLDPE ที่ผสม: mLLDPE 70–80 ส่วน, EVA copolymer 8–12 ส่วน (vinyl acetate content 10–15%), polycarbonate 3–5 ส่วน, maleic anhydride 6–10 ส่วน, dicumyl peroxide 1–3 ส่วน
- BUR สำหรับ blown film: 3–3.5
- ฟิล์มมีทิศทางการหดตัวหลักในแนว MD (unidirectional)
- สารเพิ่มความเสถียร: antioxidant (hindered phenol + phosphite ester อัตราส่วน 2–3:2) + UV absorber (benzotriazole) 0.8–1.2% ของ mLLDPE

## PE Packaging Relevance

ฟิล์มนี้ตอบโจทย์ตลาด unidirectional PE shrink label และ sleeve label สำหรับ PET bottle ขวดน้ำ และบรรจุภัณฑ์อาหาร การใช้ PE ล้วน (all-PE) ทำให้รีไซเคิลได้ง่ายกว่า PVC หรือ OPS shrink label ซึ่งสอดคล้องกับเทรนด์ mono-material recyclability ในยุโรปและจีน การมี BUR control ที่ชัดเจนทำให้ควบคุมอัตราหดตัว TD/MD ratio ได้แม่นยำ

## China Market Note

ผู้ถือสิทธิ์เป็นบริษัทจีนขนาดกลางในเซี่ยงไฮ้ ไม่พบหลักฐานการยื่น PCT ความคุ้มครองจึงจำกัดอยู่ในจีนเท่านั้น อย่างไรก็ตาม เทคโนโลยีนี้อาจมีการถ่ายทอดหรือเลียนแบบในห่วงโซ่อุปทานจีน ซึ่งอาจกระทบผู้ผลิตที่ส่งออกสินค้าเข้าตลาดจีน

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** MEDIUM

Claim หลักครอบคลุมสูตรผสม LDPE/HDPE/LLDPE/mLLDPE ในช่วงที่ค่อนข้างกว้าง (เช่น LLDPE 35–45%) ซึ่งอาจทับซ้อนกับสูตรฟิล์ม PE shrink ทั่วไป อย่างไรก็ตาม Claim ที่แคบลงเรื่อง modified mLLDPE (ที่มี PC + MAH + DCP) นั้น specific มาก ความเสี่ยงหลักอยู่ที่ Claim 1 (สูตรพื้นฐาน) หากกำลังผลิต unidirectional PE shrink film ที่มีสัดส่วนใกล้เคียงกันและส่งออกไปจีน ควรปรึกษาที่ปรึกษาสิทธิบัตร

# CN117730002A — Recyclable flexible high barrier films and bags for packaging flowable materials (Liqui-Box)

**Assignee:** Liqui-Box Corporation (US) | **Status:** FILED (PCT national phase entry) | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

สิทธิบัตรนี้ครอบคลุมฟิล์มหลายชั้นแบบ coextruded ที่ทำจาก ethylene/alpha-olefin interpolymer และ/หรือ copolymer ที่มีสมบัติ high barrier โดยใช้ EVOH (ethylene-vinyl alcohol) เป็น core barrier layer ในปริมาณน้อย (0.1–10% ของน้ำหนัก/ความหนาฟิล์มทั้งหมด) ฟิล์มมีความยืดหยุ่น ทนแรงดัดงอ (flex crack resistance) และเหมาะสำหรับผลิต bag-in-box และถุงบรรจุวัสดุที่ไหลได้ (flowable materials) ปริมาณ EVOH ที่ต่ำช่วยเพิ่มความสามารถในการรีไซเคิล

## Key Claims

- โครงสร้างขั้นต่ำ 3 ชั้น: inner sealant layer + EVOH core barrier layer + outer sealant layer
- Density ของ sealant/tie layers: 0.894–0.924 g/cm³ (ethylene/α-olefin interpolymer)
- EVOH core: 0.1–10% ของฟิล์มทั้งหมด (โดยน้ำหนักหรือความหนา); EVOH copolymer มีเอทิลีน 27–32 mol%
- โครงสร้าง 5 ชั้น: inner sealant + tie layer 1 + EVOH core + tie layer 2 + outer sealant
- โครงสร้าง 7 ชั้น: inner sealant + inner tie layers + dual EVOH cores (แยกด้วย PE tie layer) + outer tie layers + outer sealant
- Sealant/tie layers มี density รวม 0.910–0.924 g/cm³
- mLLDPE ใน tie layers: density ≥ 0.912 g/cm³
- EVOH content ในแต่ละ core layer: 0.1–5% ต่อชั้น (ใน 7-layer design)
- MFI ของ ethylene/α-olefin: ≤ 2.0 dg/min; ZSVR (zero-shear viscosity ratio): 1.15–2.5; Mw/Mn: 2.0–4.0
- EVOH mol% ตัวเลือก: 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32

## PE Packaging Relevance

สิทธิบัตรนี้ตอบโจทย์ตลาด flexible liquid packaging (bag-in-box, stand-up pouch สำหรับ dairy, juice, liquid food) ที่ต้องการ high oxygen barrier แต่ยังคง recyclability ประเด็นสำคัญคือการใช้ EVOH ในปริมาณน้อยมาก (ต่ำกว่า 10%) ซึ่งยังอนุญาตให้รีไซเคิลผ่านกระบวนการ PE stream ได้ตามมาตรฐาน APR/RecyClass บางระดับ เทคโนโลยีนี้แข่งกับ PVDC barrier และ AlOx/SiOx coating solution

สิทธิบัตรนี้เป็น PCT application (PCT/US2022/037556) ที่เข้าสู่ขั้นตอน national phase ในจีนเมื่อ 10 มกราคม 2024 โดยมี priority จากสหรัฐฯ (US 63/223,350 ปี 2021) ซึ่งหมายความว่าสิทธิบัตรนี้อาจมีความคุ้มครองในหลายประเทศ (US, EU, CN) ผ่านการยื่น PCT — นี่คือความแตกต่างสำคัญจากสิทธิบัตร CN อื่นในชุดนี้ ต้องตรวจสอบสถานะใน jurisdiction อื่นด้วย

## Abstract / Technology

สิทธิบัตรนี้ครอบคลุมฟิล์มบรรจุภัณฑ์ composite แบบ single-PE ที่ซีลร้อนได้ที่อุณหภูมิต่ำ (low-temperature heat seal) โครงสร้างฟิล์มประกอบด้วย 2 ชั้น PE film (First PE film และ Second PE film) และชั้นกลางที่พิมพ์ (intermediate printing layer) ยึดติดด้วยกระบวนการ thermal lamination (hot-press adhesion) ฟิล์มสามารถรีไซเคิลได้ ปลอดภัยและเป็นมิตรกับสิ่งแวดล้อม มีสมบัติโดยรวมดีเยี่ยม

- Surface-modified nano-SiO2 + surface-grafted HDPE → reacted in pyrimidine solvent (Na2CO3/NaHCO3 buffer pH 8.4–8.6, 35–45°C, 7–9h)

# CN118810181A — Heat-shrinkable Cushion Packaging Air Cushion Film and Manufacturing Method Thereof (Aimsen)

**Assignee:** Xiamen Aimsen New Material Technology Co., Ltd. (CN) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** LOW

## Abstract / Technology

ฟิล์มอากาศกันกระแทกชนิดหดความร้อน (heat-shrinkable air cushion film) โครงสร้างอย่างน้อย 5 ชั้นผลิตด้วยกระบวนการ multilayer co-extrusion blown film ประกอบด้วยชั้นนอก (PETG), ชั้นรองนอก (modified PETG + GMA compatibilizer + LLDPE), ชั้นแกน (LDPE), ชั้นรองใน และชั้นใน เมื่อนำฟิล์มมาขึ้นรูปเป็นถุงลมแล้วเติมอากาศ จากนั้นให้ความร้อนระยะสั้น ฟิล์มจะหดรัดรูปผลิตภัณฑ์รอบด้านโดยไม่มีมุมตาย เหมาะสำหรับสินค้าที่มีรูปทรงซับซ้อน (irregular-shaped products)

## Key Claims

- โครงสร้าง 5 ชั้น: ชั้นนอก / ชั้นรองนอก (modified pellet) / ชั้นแกน / ชั้นรองใน / ชั้นใน
- ชั้นนอก: PETG (density 1.25–1.28 g/cm³, haze < 2%, HDT ≥ 65°C and ≤ 75°C per ASTM D648 at 0.45 MPa)
- ชั้นรองนอก: PETG 35–50 wt% + GMA-modified compatibilizer 10–20 wt% + LLDPE 35–55 wt%; MFI ของ LLDPE ที่ 190°C = 1.0–2.0 g/min
- ชั้นแกน: LDPE (MFI 1.0–2.0 g/min at 190°C, haze < 8%)
- ชั้นรองใน: PP + LDPE + ethylene-based graft polyether polyol (each 35–50 wt%, graft 10–20 wt%)
- ชั้นใน (Option A): metallocene PE 50–60 wt% + LDPE 30–50 wt% + talc masterbatch 1–5 wt% + erucamide 0.5–1 wt%
- สัดส่วนความหนา: ชั้นนอก 30–35%, ชั้นรองนอก 10–15%, แกน 10–15%, ชั้นรองใน 10–15%, ชั้นใน 30–35%
- กระบวนการผลิต: multilayer co-extrusion blown film

## PE Packaging Relevance

ฟิล์มนี้ใช้ LDPE และ LLDPE เป็นส่วนประกอบสำคัญในชั้นแกนและชั้นรองนอก จึงมีความเกี่ยวข้องกับธุรกิจเรซิน PE โดยตรง อย่างไรก็ตามสัดส่วนหลักของโครงสร้างคือ PETG ทำให้ตลาดเป้าหมายเป็น specialty cushion packaging ไม่ใช่ฟิล์มบรรจุภัณฑ์ PE ทั่วไป การประยุกต์ใช้เพื่อป้องกันสินค้าแบบ all-around shrink cushioning เป็น niche market ที่แตกต่างจาก standard PE shrink film

## FTO Assessment

**Risk:** LOW

สิทธิบัตรนี้ยื่นในจีนเท่านั้น (CN application) สถานะยังเป็น FILED ยังไม่ได้รับการอนุมัติ โครงสร้างฟิล์มเน้น PETG เป็นองค์ประกอบหลักของชั้นนอก ไม่ใช่ multilayer PE film ล้วน ผู้ผลิต PE resin ที่ไม่ได้ผลิตหรือจำหน่ายในจีนแทบไม่มีความเสี่ยง แม้แต่ในจีน scope ของสิทธิบัตรก็จำกัดเฉพาะโครงสร้างผสม PETG+PE ซึ่งไม่ครอบคลุม standard PE shrink film

# EP3037262B1 — Shrink Labels (UPM Raflatac)

**Assignee:** UPM Raflatac Oy (FI) | **Status:** GRANTED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

สิทธิบัตรนี้ครอบคลุม shrink label และวิธีการติดฉลากบนบรรจุภัณฑ์ โดยใช้ฟิล์มหน้า (face film) ที่มีโครงสร้างหลายชั้นประกอบด้วย cyclic olefin copolymer (COC) ร่วมกับ polyethylene (copolymer of ethylene/1-octene หรือ ethylene/hexene) ฟิล์มถูกยืด (uniaxial orientation) ในทิศทาง transverse direction (TD) ด้วย draw ratio ≥ 3 ที่อุณหภูมิ 50–130°C เพื่อให้ได้คุณสมบัติหดตัวในช่วง 20–75% ที่อุณหภูมิ 65–98°C การใช้ตัวทำละลาย (alpha-pinene, limonene, THF blend ฯลฯ) เชื่อมต่อฉลากเป็น sleeve รอบบรรจุภัณฑ์ก่อนเข้าอุโมงค์ความร้อน

## Key Claims

- ฟิล์มหน้าหลายชั้น: ชั้นผิว (skin layer 1) + ชั้นแกน (core) + ชั้นผิว (skin layer 2) — โครงสร้าง 3 ชั้น
- Cyclic olefin copolymer (COC): copolymer ของ norbornene+ethene เป็น one polymer; อีก polymer คือ COC ของ norbornene+ethene
- Polyethylene component: copolymer of ethylene and 1-octene หรือ ethylene and hexene
- Uniaxial orientation ratio ≥ 3 ในทิศทาง transverse direction (TD)
- Stretching temperature: 50–130°C; cooling: degreasing temperature profile 20–80°C
- Shrink capability: 20–75% ในทิศ TD ที่ 65–98°C
- Seaming solvent: alpha-pinene, limonene, THF/1,3-dioxolane mixture, o-chlorotoluene, 4-chlorotoluene, p-chlorobenzotrifluoride
- Application temperature: 65–140°C (heating in shrink tunnel)
- ครอบคลุมทั้งฉลาก (label/article combination) และวิธีการผลิต/ติดฉลาก

## PE Packaging Relevance

สิทธิบัตรนี้ใช้ polyethylene (ethylene copolymer กับ 1-octene หรือ hexene) เป็นส่วนประกอบร่วมกับ COC ในฟิล์ม shrink label ซึ่งเป็นตลาดที่ PE resin มีส่วนร่วม อย่างไรก็ตาม application หลักคือ shrink sleeve label บนขวด/บรรจุภัณฑ์แข็ง ไม่ใช่ flexible packaging ฟิล์มเอง UPM Raflatac เป็นผู้ผลิต label ชั้นนำของยุโรป สิทธิบัตรนี้ได้รับการอนุมัติในยุโรปแล้ว (granted 2024-05) ครอบคลุม 36 ประเทศสมาชิก EPC

## Abstract / Technology

# EP4334132A1 — Multilayer Stretch Film with Cling Properties (Trinovamed)

**Assignee:** Trinovamed AG (CH) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

สิทธิบัตรนี้คือ multilayer stretch film สำหรับการพันรัด (stretch wrapping) ที่มีคุณสมบัติยึดเกาะ (cling) โดยไม่ต้องใช้สาร cling additive จากภายนอก โครงสร้างประกอบด้วยชั้นที่ยึดเกาะได้ (clingable first layer) และชั้นที่ไม่ยึดติดกัน (non-sticking second layer) เพื่อให้ฟิล์มสามารถคลี่ออกจาก roll ได้ราบรื่นและพันรัดพาเลทได้โดยไม่ติดกัน ฟิล์มนี้ผลิตด้วยกระบวนการ cast extrusion และผสม LLDPE เป็น base resin หลัก

## Key Claims

- Multilayer stretch film: ชั้น clingable first layer (1) + non-clingable second layer (2)
- First layer (clingable): ประกอบด้วย copolymer composition ในช่วง 1–41 wt% ethylene และ polyethylene (LLDPE) ในช่วง 2–29 wt% alpha-olefin content
- Second layer: ประกอบด้วย polyethylene คือ LLDPE ที่ผลิตด้วย single-site catalyst (sLLDPE)
- Cling value ของ first layer ≥ 50 g (วัดด้วย ASTM D4649) และ non-cling value ของ second layer ≤ 50 g
- Cling ของ first layer เกิดจาก compatibility ของ copolymer composition กับ sLLDPE ใน second layer
- กระบวนการผลิต: cast extrusion; ฟิล์มสามารถ scale up ผลิตในอุตสาหกรรมได้ง่าย
- ครอบคลุมทั้ง multilayer stretch film และกระบวนการผลิต (method claims)
- Applicant: TRINOVAMED AG (CH); Inventors: MCC, Martin; VAN BOYEN, Walter; PCT WO 2022/233161

## PE Packaging Relevance

สิทธิบัตรนี้มีความเกี่ยวข้องกับ PE packaging โดยตรง เนื่องจาก base resin หลักคือ LLDPE และ sLLDPE ซึ่งเป็น core product ของ PE resin producers stretch film สำหรับพันพาเลทเป็น high-volume application ที่ใช้ LLDPE จำนวนมาก การพัฒนา intrinsic cling โดยไม่ใช้ additive เป็นทิศทางที่น่าสนใจสำหรับตลาด sustainable packaging เนื่องจากลด contamination ใน recycling stream สิทธิบัตรนี้ยังอยู่ในขั้น FILED (A1) จึงยังไม่ได้รับการอนุมัติ แต่ควรติดตามความคืบหน้า

# EP4484491A1 — Polyethylene Resin Composition (LG Chem)

**Assignee:** LG Chem, Ltd. | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

LG Chem discloses a polyethylene resin composition comprising an ethylene/C4–C10 alpha-olefin copolymer engineered specifically for biaxially oriented polyethylene (BOPE) film production. The composition is characterized by a controlled crystal structure — measured via Successive Self-nucleation and Annealing (SSA) analysis — that yields excellent stretchability in both machine direction (MD) and transverse direction (TD) without defects such as shrinkage during TD stretching. The invention addresses the growing demand for "All-PE" mono-material packaging as a recyclable alternative to multi-layer composite films incorporating BOPA, BOPET, or BOPP layers.

## Key Claims

- Ethylene/C4–C10 alpha-olefin copolymer composition meeting three simultaneous requirements:
  - (a1) SSA ratio W_LC/W_HC ≥ 0.1 (low-crystalline content at Tm ≤ 100°C vs. high-crystalline content at Tm ≥ 120°C)
  - (a2) Density ≥ 0.940 g/cm³ per ASTM D1505
  - (a3) Melt index (MI₂.₁₆) = 0.1–10 g/10 min at 190°C / 2.16 kg per ASTM D1238
- Biaxially stretched film (BOPE) comprising the above resin composition
- Crystal structure controlled to allow interlamellar lateral linking enabling secondary crystallization delay during MD stretching, facilitating subsequent TD stretching

## PE Packaging Relevance

Directly relevant to the mono-material All-PE packaging trend. A successful BOPE resin from LG Chem — a major global PE producer — could compete with or displace incumbent BOPE grades (e.g., from Borealis, SABIC) in food packaging laminate structures. If commercialized, this resin composition could serve as a print-layer or barrier-layer substitute in PE-only laminates, supporting recyclability compliance under PPWR and EPR frameworks. The density specification (≥ 0.940 g/cm³, HDPE range) is distinctive and differs from typical LLDPE-based BOPE approaches.

# JP2025101849A — Shrink Film and Multilayer Shrink Film (Yazaki Energy System)

**Assignee:** Yazaki Energy System Corporation | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** LOW

## Abstract / Technology

Yazaki Energy System Corporation (Tokyo, Japan; applicant ID 501418498) discloses a polyethylene shrink film formulation that achieves high heat shrinkability and transparency simultaneously even when using low-crystallinity PE — a historically difficult combination since transparent (low-crystallinity) PE tends to exhibit poor shrink rates. The solution is a specific blend of two PE grades combined with ultrafine silica and glycerin fatty acid ester as functional additives, allowing the conflicting properties of transparency and heat shrinkability to be balanced in a single mono-PE shrink film or multilayer construction. # JP2026009066A — Self-adhesive plastic wrap film for food and its manufacturing method (Rongxin New Material)

**Assignee:** Rongxin New Material (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. + Kabushiki Kaisha R (JP co-applicant) | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** MEDIUM

## Abstract / Technology

This invention relates to food freshness preservation technology and discloses a self-adhesive (cling) plastic wrap film with a three-layer structure: outer barrier layer, middle layer, and inner antimicrobial layer. The barrier layer is a blend of polyethylene (HDPE, LDPE, or LLDPE) and polypropylene; the middle layer contains a melt-blend of at least two types of polyethylene; and the antimicrobial layer contains a thermoplastic elastomer (SEBS) and nano-silver particles. The film is co-extruded using three screws and then embossed with a convex roller to form a micro-textured antimicrobial surface that provides cling, oil resistance, gas barrier, moisture resistance, and heat-seal properties.

## Key Claims

- Claim 1: Three-layer food wrap film — barrier layer (PE/PP blend), middle layer (≥2 PE types melt-blended), antimicrobial layer (thermoplastic elastomer + antimicrobial agent); PE types include HDPE, LDPE, or LLDPE

# WO2025259698A1 — Recyclable Forming Film (Amcor Flexibles NA)

**Assignee:** Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. | **Status:** FILED | **FTO Risk:** LOW

## Abstract / Technology

This patent covers a multilayer thermoform packaging film comprising a polyamide (PA) layer, a polyethylene (PE) layer, and a polyethylene or ethylene vinyl alcohol copolymer (EVOH) layer, among others. The film is unoriented (cast/thermoformable) and is designed so that polyamide constitutes less than 50% by weight of the total film composition — a "reduced PA content" claim intended to position it as more recyclable than conventional high-PA thermoform films. The outer polyamide layer has a specifically defined relative thickness to optimize mechanical performance for food packaging thermoforming applications.

## Key Claims

- Multilayer unoriented (non-oriented) forming film for thermoformed packaging
- Layer stack includes: polyamide (PA) outer layer + polyethylene (PE) layer + PE or EVOH copolymer layer (among others)
- PA content is less than 50% by weight of total film — defined as the "recyclability" feature
- Outer PA layer has a specific relative thickness (ratio) for mechanical property optimization
- Targeted application: thermoformed food packaging trays/containers (see FIG. 2 — tray shape)
- Filed PCT/US2025/033050; priority from US 63/658,755 (11 June 2024)
- Assignee: Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. (Neenah, WI, US)

## PE Packaging Relevance

**NOT a mono-material PE film.** This is a hybrid PA/PE/EVOH multilayer thermoform structure. The "recyclable" claim rests on reducing PA content below 50 wt% rather than eliminating non-PE layers — this does not meet current European RecyClass or PE mono-material criteria for PE stream recycling. PE relevance is secondary: PE layers provide sealability and flexibility within the structure, but the patent's core innovation is PA layer thickness ratio management, not PE resin performance. This film would not be recyclable in standard PE film collection streams (yellow bag / PE film recycling) due to retained PA and EVOH content. Low strategic relevance for GC's PE resin business; monitor only for competitive intelligence on Amcor's thermoform film portfolio and PPWR compliance claims.

# EPR

## Theme Overview

Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) schemes require packaging producers to fund the collection, sorting, and recycling of packaging waste. Fee structures are increasingly **modulated** — recyclable packaging pays less; hard-to-recycle packaging pays more.

**Key programs tracked:**

- **EU PPWR** (Aug 2026): EPR mandatory across all EU member states; harmonised approach
- **UK PackUK** (2026–2029): Modulated disposal fees based on recyclability tier; published June 2025, updated Feb 2026
- **US States** (CA, CO, ME, MD, MN, OR, WA): 7 state programs at various implementation stages
- **Asia-Pacific**: EPR rollout expanding — South Korea, Taiwan, Japan FCM recycling rules

**Why tracked:** EPR modulation creates a direct financial incentive for brand owners to switch from hard-to-recycle multi-layer laminates to recyclable mono-PE structures. PE film producers that can certify recyclability gain pricing power and preferred supplier status.

**Update — May 2026:**

- UK PackUK modulated fees begin 2026. Fee schedule penalises non-recyclable materials, rewards PE mono-material and easy-peel structures

## EPR in Southeast Asia — Update (Source: ASEAN Circularity Coalition, May 2026)

### สถานะ EPR ใน 4 ประเทศ ASEAN ที่บังคับใช้แล้ว

| ประเทศ | ปีที่บังคับใช้ | กฎหมาย | ขอบเขต PE |
| ------ | ------------ | ------ | --------- |
| อินโดนีเซีย | 2019 | Government Regulation 27/2020 | Flexible plastic packaging ครบวงจร |
| สิงคโปร์ | 2020 / 2026 | Resource Sustainability Act | EPR สำหรับ packaging เริ่ม 2026 |
| ฟิลิปปินส์ | 2022 | EPR Act (RA 11898) | Rigid and **flexible** plastic packaging |
| เวียดนาม | 2022 | Decree 08/2022 | ครอบคลุม non-biodegradable packaging |

### Malaysia — EPR บังคับใช้ 2026

- **Malaysia Plastics Sustainability Roadmap** ระบุชัดว่า **HDPE** และ **LDPE/LLDPE** เป็น resins ที่อยู่ใต้บังคับ EPR
- EPR mandatory ภายใน 2026 — ผู้ export PE resin และ film ไปมาเลเซียต้องเตรียม traceability และ recyclability documentation

### ประเทศไทย — EPR เป้าหมาย 2027

- กำหนดเป้า mandatory EPR ปี 2027 ตาม Draft Sustainable Packaging Management Act
- ขณะนี้อยู่ระหว่างกระบวนการนิติบัญญัติ

### อินโดนีเซีย — เป้าหมายเพิ่มเติม (2030)

- **ลดปริมาณ plastic packaging 30%** ภายใน 2030 (mandatory reduction mandate)
- **แบนถุงพลาสติกแบบใช้ครั้งเดียว** ทั้งหมดภายใน 2030
- ฟิลิปปินส์, อินโดนีเซีย, ไทย ติดอันดับ **top globally สำหรับ ocean plastic leakage** — เป็น political justification สำหรับกฎที่เข้มงวดขึ้น

### Draft ILBI (Global Plastic Treaty)

- ร่างสนธิสัญญาพลาสติกโลก (Intergovernmental Legally Binding Instrument) มีบทบัญญัติที่ **สนับสนุน EPR** ในระดับโลก
- แม้ INC-5.2 (สิงหาคม 2025) จะยังไม่มีข้อตกลง แต่ mome
